Commentary.Commentary: Well, we were ready in store to witness the first ODI between USA and Ireland, but the news coming in is that the GAME HAS BEEN CANCELLED. There have been positive cases of Covid-19 right from the time Ireland set foot in the United States but the tour still went on. However, now, a case has been reported in the umpiring team and as a result, there is no official available for the game. There were four umpires assigned for the match and the remaining three have tested negative, but having been in close contact with the first, all four have been ruled out as well. To add to the woes, a net bowler from the USA camp has also tested positive and that puts the remaining two ODIs under serious doubt, given that they are not too far apart. A final call will be taken on Boxing Day to see if the second and third ODIs can be played as scheduled.
